thread:
maria: Quick sync - we need quota/limit bumps in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 to support a new Dedicated GPU customer. Details below, please review and flag any missing items.

raj: what instance types and exact counts are you requesting? also which AWS accounts?

maria: plan: p4d (A100-equivalent) for heavy training-like inference, plus g5 family for lower-cost burst inference. Account IDs: 111122223333 (prod-us), 444455556666 (prod-eu). Region-level increases.

Requested targets (region-level):
- us-west-2: baseline 30 x p4d.24xlarge, burst up to 50 during peak windows, request quota to 60 to include 20% headroom (so we can stage 30->45->60). g5 baseline 60, burst 100 -> request 120.
- eu-west-1: baseline 12 x p4d.24xlarge, burst 20 -> request 24. g5 baseline 30, burst 50 -> request 60.

Also need network and storage limits: ENI quota -> 500 in each region, VPC prefix and route table entries increased (we're hitting NAT gateway + route table limits with many small subnets), and higher EBS bandwidth/IOPS for gp3 volumes.

kevin: I'll open support cases with AWS. Suggested CLI example for instance limit (adjust quota codes as needed):
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216A2F2 --desired-value 60 --region us-west-2
```
Please confirm exact quota codes and phrasing for the cases.

maria: use language: "EC2 On-Demand instance limit increases for p4d and g5 in support of Redwood Dedicated GPU pool (prod). Baseline required 30 p4d with burst to 50; request increase to 60 for 20% headroom. Account ID: 111122223333. Staged increases acceptable." Add ENI=500 and EBS throughput uplift.

infra-bot: created AWS support case 987654321 for us-west-2 quota requests: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321 :eyes:

kevin: case 987654322 created for eu-west-1. Marked both as urgent. I'll ping our AWS rep.

sophie: finance note: any sustained committed capacity that raises monthly committed spend > $200k needs Procurement + Legal approvals. Estimated baseline on-demand cost for us-west-2 p4d baseline ~ $930/hr (~$670k/mo) before discounts; with reserved commitments expect ~30-45% off. We need procurement to prepare reservation negotiation.

procurement-bot: tagging procurement and legal — will start approval flow for reserved commitments if infra confirms expected committed monthly spend.

raj: capacity planning proposal: commit 80% of baseline as reserved capacity (so 24/30 p4d in us-west-2) and leave the rest for burst. Autoscaling policy: maintain min=baseline_reserve, max=burst_target, scale-out with FIFO queue length and tail latency SLO.

maria: add 20% buffer above burst for AZ failover and preemption risk -> quota requests should be burst_target * 1.2 (rounded). That yields us-west-2 p4d quota 60, eu-west-1 quota 24.

kevin: I'll request region-level increases (not per-AZ) and note that staged increases are fine. ETA from AWS when urgent = usually 48-72h if rep engaged, otherwise longer.

ops-oncall: after quotas are granted, let's run a post-provision checklist: confirm ENI counts per-node, validate IAM roles for instance profiles, check EBS throughput via fio, tag instances with cost-center/team, and verify autoscaler picks up new capacity. We should also pre-warm AMIs with optimized drivers (CUDA + MPS) and node labels: pool=p4d-prod-us, pool=g5-burst-us, pool=p4d-prod-eu.

maria: timeline: need baseline capacity in 5 business days for onboarding. Kevin, please push for expedited review and post case updates here. I'll prepare a short runbook for post-quota verification and Terraform changes.

kevin: will do. Following up with AWS rep now and marking cases urgent. I'll paste case updates as they come.

sophie: I'll coordinate with procurement to start reservation approval and get cost modeling. If we can get staged increases approved faster, finance can sign off on the first tranche to meet the 5-day goal.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll sync with raj and ops-oncall to finalize Terraform modules and node pool definitions once quotas are confirmed.

kevin: update: AWS case 987654321 status = 'Waiting for AWS' (submitted). Escalated to rep.

infra-bot: added checklist item: verify route table limits after VPC prefix increase and confirm nat gateway throughput.

maria: note for docs: include guidance on how to request increases (copyable snippet for the support case), recommended staged targets, and finance threshold for reserved commitments. I'll draft and drop into docs repo when we have final numbers.
